name: Komiya Rokusuke
source: An elderly man who works as the security guard at Yamakawa's mansion.  Along with Fumie, he discovered the dead body.  He has no relatives, and apparently has been drowning his loneliness every day by drinking.  In addition, he is a timid man, and always appears nervous.
